values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica price block on the dated site page(s) (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/loyalsock/camping ('may be reserved up to eleven months in advance'; 'Stays are limited to seven nights'; 'Check in and check out time is 3:00 P.M. note: Three sites strung along the western end of High Knob Road, counted from Dry Run Road (3.8 miles up from PA 87): 720 at 0.4 mile, an open gravel pad at the end of a gravel driveway about 110 ft long that the booking page lists as a moderate grade; 723 at 1 mile and 724 at 1.3 miles, both open grass clearings on the north side with grass driveways. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs; its campsite map layer calls 720 a large open site suitable for a large trailer or RV. 720 has 15 ft of overhead clearance, the other two are open to the sky. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
